description: Find a treatment using context counts, text patterns and supplied metadata. Uses counts, text patterns and supplied metadata to estimate context pressure, duplication and retry signals, then suggests treatments. Scores are heuristics, not a diagnosis. Never required. Registration required. Live price: see list_treatments.

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.

attempts.description: Attempts made at the current step.

context.description: Optional raw context; only statistics are derived from it.

contextTokens.description: Your own estimate of current context size.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries with the same key return the same run and are never charged twice.

max_price_credits.description: Maximum price you accept, from list_treatments. A higher live price is refused without charging.

reason.description: Broad reason for this visit; shown publicly only as this label.

taskClass.description: Broad class of your work; shown publicly only as this label.
